text.tspan: LSTM (packed IMDB classifier) | Operators & tensor flow
IMDB / embedding 128 / hidden 256 / one direction / packed sequences / read bottom to top
T: padded sequence length; B: batch; V: realized vocabulary; E=128; H=256
external inputs pink / forward logits purple / caller threshold gray / Sigmoid green
lengths enter packing through a side port; recurrent weights are shared across time
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span (hover a module); dashed = named state / auxiliary input; fork-join = tuple/list, not sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
